title: microfiber fitted sheet
text: microfiber fitted sheet. I purchased these to help my grandsons silky sleeping bags from slipping off a cot cover that was also silky.  Works perfectly.  Washing and dried beautifully.  VERY stretchy.  I put them over a 4" memory foam pad, but they would stretch over thicker pad for sure - sooooo much stretch.

product_metadata.title: COSMOPLUS Fitted Sheet Twin Fitted Sheet Only（No Flat Sheet or Pillow Shams）,4 Way Stretch Micro-Knit,Snug Fit,Wrinkle Free,for Standard Mattress and Air Bed Mattress from 8” Up to 10”,Light Gray
features: Premium Microfiber Fabric – Our deep-fitted sheets are knitted with a soft,breathable micro-brushed fiber with spandex knit for ultimate sleep comfort.
Smart, Snug, Stretch-Fit – A magic 4-way high stretch technology helps keep our iron free sheets in place without slipping, sliding, or bunching up even if you move.
All-Night Support – The enhanced air flow and moisture-wicking design allows your body to stay cool and relaxed throughout the night to wake up feeling refreshed.
Versatile Colors and Sizing – We offer our fitted sheets in twin, full, queen, and king sizes, as well as lavish bedroom colors such as white, gray, light gray, navy and taupe.

Suitable for traditional Mattress and Air Bed Mattress from 8" up to 10" – The deep-pocketed fitted sheet design and 4-way corner stretch helps the better fit blow-up traditional mattress and air mattress for guests or travel comfort.
